evaluation.overall_comment: The translation contains pervasive lexical, grammatical, and syntactic errors that severely compromise its quality. Numerous words are mistranslated or nonsensical (e.g., "psi i andre" for "psi squared", "labban", "storslangt parallel", "verler", "uinntellig"), breaking both fluency and technical accuracy. While the conversational structure is roughly maintained, the scientific discourse is obscured by incorrect terminology and awkward phrasing. Significant revision is needed to meet basic standards of Norwegian physics communication and podcast naturalness.
